rows.evidence: Missing entirely: apply and exec are one synchronous flow; no release capability, no replay/generation/post-stop/expiry semantics anywhere (grep-confirmed).

rows.title: Stop/activate/wait races tested
rows.evidence: No loom/miri/fuzz in repo; no wait API even in CLI; only concurrency artifact is a fixed-sleep socket roundtrip test (supervisor/socket.rs:851) and ENV_LOCK test serialization. Harness must be built from scratch.

rows.evidence: AccessMode is Read/Write/ReadWrite only (capability.rs:86-93), bundling disclosed in docs/cli/internals/landlock.mdx. macOS exec unconditional ((allow process-exec*) macos.rs:555); atomic-write is CLI regex hack (capability_ext.rs:434-460); unix-socket separately modeled (honest).
